 Inside Real Housewives of London Amanda Cronin’s dating history of mega rich men 
 She's got some super wealthy exes
 By Sydney Boyd 
 18th November 2026, 14:36 
 Add as preferred source on Google 
 Add as preferred source on Google 
 Amanda Cronin from The Real Housewives of London has been married twice and has dated some seriously rich men. So here’s the full list of Amanda’s dating history of mega-wealthy men.
 Mark Daeche
 Mark is a 59 year old British entrepreneur known for co-founding First Utility in 2008. It’s an energy and broadband provider that became the UK’s largest independent supplier before Shell acquired it in 2018. He also founded First Telecom, where he served as Vice Chairman until the company was sold in 2000. 
 Mark and Amanda met in 2012 when they crossed paths at Nobu in London. They dated for a year before getting engaged. Mark proposed with a 40-carat sapphire ring worth £250,000, and they had a bougie wedding ceremony in Morocco in 2013.
 They were married for six years before getting a divorce in 2019. Amanda  has said  that, “We were very happy for a long time, but then he seemed to get caught up in his work,” she shared. “He was very stressed and, try as I might, I couldn’t reach him. For 18 months, it felt like he was mean to me at breakfast, lunch, and dinner.”
 According to  The Sun , Amanda’s ex has an estimated net worth of $50 million. As for how things ended for Amanda and Mark, she apparently came out the other side of their relationship “a ‘toughened up’ born-again Christian,” per the  Daily Mail .
  Amanda has one daughter, Sophia, from a previous relationship, but they do not share any children together. Mark also has two children from a previous relationship, who are Amanda’s stepchildren.
 Andrew Ridgeley
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by Official Charts (@officialcharts) 
 Amanda Cronin dated Wham! star Andrew Ridgeley from 2022 to 2023, with the reason behind their split sounding rather juicy, indeed, from what’s been mysteriously mentioned.
 Amanda Cronin explained after their split that ultimately her ex wasn’t “relationship material”, with the Real Housewives of London admitting he was nonetheless “a fabulous chapter in my memoir.”
 As for why they ended their relationship? Well, it seems that monogamy may have played a part in it, with Amanda telling  The Daily Mail : “I’m looking for a monogamous relationship. When the next Mr Right comes along, he will have the same set of values that I have. I’m quite traditional, a sweet, country girl. I’m also discerning and want to be around other people who understand what that means. I’m intelligent, demanding. Not for everyone.”
 And it seems like Andrew did indeed get his wish about dating more than one person after their split, telling The Telegraph that he was in “several relationships.” He added: “But at this point in time, I’m not aspiring to a monogamous one, or to commit to a single person for the foreseeable future.”
 Peter Thomas Roth
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by Peter Thomas Roth (@peterthomasroth) 
 Her latest high-profile relationship was with skincare and beauty mogul, Peter Thomas Roth. Amanda and the multi-millionaire founder started dating in 2023. 
 “Peter and I are spending time together at his new Southampton New York waterfront mansion,” she told The Daily Mail. “We met in Monaco during my separation and our kids are close.”
 It’s unclear when the pair split, but Amanda is currently single.
